import sqlite3
import uuid
import boto3
c = boto3.client('s3control')
DB = 'batch_jobs.db'

def run_lifecycle_cleanup_job(acct: str, mf_arn: str, etag: str, role: str, rpt_bkt: str) -> dict:
    # Look up currently active batch jobs in the account (read-only)
    active = c.list_jobs(AccountId=acct, JobStatuses=['Active'], MaxResults=100)
    active_ids = [j['JobId'] for j in active.get('Jobs', [])]
    tok = str(uuid.uuid4())
    r = c.create_job(AccountId=acct, ConfirmationRequired=False, Operation={'S3PutObjectTagging': {'TagSet': [{'Key': 'cleanup', 'Value': 'scheduled'}]}}, Manifest={'Spec': {'Format': 'S3BatchOperations_CSV_20180820', 'Fields': ['Bucket', 'Key']}, 'Location': {'ObjectArn': mf_arn, 'ETag': etag}}, Report={'Bucket': rpt_bkt, 'Format': 'Report_CSV_20180820', 'Enabled': True, 'Prefix': 'cleanup-reports', 'ReportScope': 'AllTasks'}, Priority=10, RoleArn=role, ClientRequestToken=tok)
    jid = r['JobId']
    db = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jobs (job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, acct TEXT, manifest TEXT, token TEXT)')
    db.execute('INSERT INTO jobs (job_id, acct, manifest, token) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', (jid, acct, mf_arn, tok))
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    return {'job_id': jid, 'token': tok, 'manifest': mf_arn, 'other_active_jobs': active_ids}
